newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PM, DEFENSE MIN TO MEET FRI OVER ARMS DEAL.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PM, DEFENSE MIN TO MEET FRI OVER ARMS DEAL.

text.p: Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis will meet with National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou and Defence minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos to discuss Greece's five-year arms deal, government spokesman Dimitris Reppas said.
Defense Minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos said in parliament that the arms deal is going to cost "some trillions", Deputy Defense Minister Dimitris Apostolakis has put the cost at 1.0 trillion drachmas.
Prime Minister Costas Simitis has said part of the arms deal could be funded by foreign borrowing.
The final decision on the arms deal is expected to be taken within November. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Costas Paris, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
